gridFee.peakDefinition: highest 15-min average import power in the billing year (kW)
gridFee.utilisationHoursRule: Full-load hours h = annual import kWh / annual peak kW. If h < 2500 the 'below2500h' pair applies, otherwise 'atOrAbove2500h'. The two pairs meet at 2500 h, so the bill equals the cheaper of the two (a concave function of the peak).

monthlyOption.note: Monatsleistungspreis option, not modelled in v1

lossCorrectionFactor.note: applied by DSO only when metering is not at the connection level; ignored

gridFee.source: Netz Leipzig GmbH, Preisblatt Netznutzungsentgelte Strom 2026 (final), gueltig ab 01.01.2026, p. 2-3
gridFee.read: full text of pages 1-3 extracted and read

kwkg.label: KWKG-Umlage 2026
kwkg.source: Uebertragungsnetzbetreiber, Umlagen 2026 (netztransparenz.de), as reproduced on DSO levy sheets (e.g. Thueringer Energienetze 'Umlagen Strom' 2026)

concession.label: Konzessionsabgabe, Sondervertragskunden (section 2 (3) no. 1 KAV)
concession.note: maximum rate for special-contract customers; exemption possible below the Grenzpreis (section 2 (4) KAV), not modelled. Low-voltage supply can count as Tarifkunde (section 2 (7) KAV) with higher rates.
concession.read: statute paragraph read via secondary reproductions

electricityTax.label: Stromsteuer (section 3 StromStG); reduced to the EU minimum for manufacturing via relief (section 9b StromStG) from 2026
electricityTax.note: the reduced rate is granted on application to the customs office, not automatically
electricityTax.source: StromStG; IHK and supplier summaries of the 2026 change
electricityTax.read: secondary summaries (IHK Lippe-Detmold, Vattenfall); statute not read in full

export.rule: PV export earns the day-ahead price; zero when the price is negative
export.basis: Direct marketing at market value; section 51 EEG (Solarspitzengesetz, plants commissioned from 25.02.2025): no payment in negative-price periods. Market premium (Marktpraemie) NOT modelled.
export.read: secondary summaries; statute not read in full
export.batteryExport: not allowed in v1 (behind-the-meter only; avoids mixed-use metering rules)

outlook.agnes: BNetzA draft determination AgNes (GBK-25-01-1#3, 6 Aug 2026): for consumers > 100 MWh/yr the annual peak price would be replaced by a booked-capacity price from 2029. Not modelled.
